quick_skim.title: Improved Approximation for Unsplittable CVRP via a Greedy Approach
quick_skim.abstract: We devise a polynomial-time $3.159$-approximation algorithm for the metric unsplittable Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem. We build on the Relative Greedy Algorithm suggested by Traub (2025), which can be considered as a variant of the LP rounding algorithm of Friggstad, Mousavi, Rahgoshay, and Salavatipour (2025). Our main ingredient is the Average Greedy Algorithm, a new algorithm that controls both tour costs and the coverage of clients with high demand. This additional control enables a sharper averaging argument for the cost of subsequent greedy choices. Similarly to Zhao and Xiao (2026), combining the Average Greedy with variants of tour partitioning and a matching algorithm yields the final approximation guarantee.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: 3.159-approximation for vehicle routing, closely related to TSP-style routing

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The metric unsplittable Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem lacked strong approximations; building on a relative greedy algorithm, this paper gives a polynomial-time 3.159-approximation via an Average Greedy Algorithm controlling tour cost and high-demand coverage.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 度量不可分割容量车辆路径问题要求同一客户的需求必须由一辆车一次服务，是经典VRP的困难变体。本文在相对贪心算法基础上提出平均贪心算法，同时控制路径成本与高需求客户的覆盖。结合路径划分与匹配技术，最终得到多项式时间的3.159近似算法。该结果改进了不可分割CVRP的近似比，展示了贪心与平均论证结合在路径类组合优化问题中的威力。

quick_skim.title: A Metaheuristic Optimization Framework for Discrete Optimization under Strict Time Limits
quick_skim.abstract: Real-time applications often rely on optimization approaches that can find high-quality solutions to hard problems on the order of milliseconds. Metaheuristic optimization frameworks (MOFs) are useful tools for such tasks, as they provide large sets of general-purpose search mechanisms that can return solutions under different computational budgets. However, existing work largely overlooks the available computation time as an explicit dimension of analysis. In this work, we introduce STILO, a MOF specifically designed for optimization under strict time limits. STILO integrates fine-grained configuration spaces for ant colony optimization (ACO), genetic algorithm (GA), and simulated annealing (SA), combining existing and novel operators. We performed experiments using both synthetic and benchmark instances of various discrete optimization problems. The results indicate that the proposed discrete distance calculation mechanism for SA is useful for optimization under strict time limits. They also show that the relative effectiveness of the proposed problem-independent graph structures for ACO can vary across time limits, even for the same instance characteristics. More generally, the results demonstrate that the effectiveness of algorithm families and operators depends not only on the problem type, but also on the characteristics of the instance and the available computational budget.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Metaheuristic framework for discrete optimization with ACO, GA, SA, transferable to ATSP heuristics.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper introduces STILO, a metaheuristic optimization framework for discrete optimization under strict time limits, integrating ant colony, genetic algorithms, and simulated annealing with fine-grained configuration. It is a general heuristic tool potentially applicable to ATSP, though not evaluated on TSP.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文针对实时应用中毫秒级求解硬组合优化问题的需求，指出现有元启发式框架忽视计算时间这一显式分析维度。作者提出STILO框架，为蚁群优化、遗传算法和模拟退火集成细粒度配置空间，并引入新算子以在严格时间限制下返回高质量解。该框架属于通用启发式方法，理论上可迁移至ATSP的启发式求解，但论文本身未在TSP实例上验证。
